cases.indication: Reduction of elevated blood pressure in adults
cases.title: Onion supplementation and health metabolic parameters: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
cases.text: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials found onion supplementation improved blood-pressure outcomes in adults.

cases.indication: Reduction of systolic and diastolic blood pressure in adults
cases.title: Effects of celery (Apium graveolens) on blood pressure, glycemic and lipid profile in adults
cases.text: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 10 randomized trials in 511 participants reported significant improvement in systolic and diastolic blood pressure.

cases.indication: Reduction of LDL cholesterol and insulin resistance in adults
cases.title: Effects of Anethum graveolens supplementation on lipid profile and glycemic control
cases.text: Meta-analysis of seven randomized trials found significant decreases in LDL cholesterol, serum insulin and HOMA-IR; other lipid and glucose outcomes were not uniformly changed.

cases.indication: Temporary loss of appetite and mild digestive complaints
cases.title: Assessment report on Achillea millefolium L., herba – revision 1
cases.text: EMA HMPC describes this as a traditional herbal medicinal product for temporary loss of appetite and mild digestive complaints, supported by long-standing use.

cases.indication: Minor mouth ulcers and inflammation of the mouth
cases.title: Community herbal monograph on Commiphora molmol, gummi-resina
cases.text: EMA HMPC describes myrrh for minor mouth ulcers and oral inflammation as a traditional herbal medicinal product based on long-standing use.

cases.indication: Mild indigestion and temporary loss of appetite
cases.title: Centaurii herba – European herbal monograph/assessment
cases.text: EMA HMPC supports centaury for mild indigestion and temporary loss of appetite under traditional use based on long-standing medicinal use.

cases.indication: Relief of cough associated with a cold
cases.title: Assessment report on Plantago lanceolata L., folium – revision 1
cases.text: EMA HMPC describes oral Plantago lanceolata leaf preparations for relief of cough associated with a cold as traditional herbal medicinal products.

cases.indication: Reduction of elevated cholesterol and LDL cholesterol
cases.title: Effect of bergamot on lipid profile in humans: a systematic review
cases.text: Systematic review found that most included clinical studies reported reductions in total cholesterol and LDL cholesterol, but preparations and study designs varied.

cases.indication: Reduction of anxiety symptoms in adults
cases.title: Rosa damascena Mill for treating adults anxiety, depression and stress: systematic review and meta-analysis
cases.text: Systematic review and meta-analysis found a beneficial pooled effect on state anxiety, while certainty across outcomes ranged from very low to moderate and stronger trials were recommended.

cases.indication: Clinical treatment of dengue infection
cases.title: Carica papaya extract in dengue: a systematic review and meta-analysis
cases.text: Systematic review concluded that current evidence is insufficient to determine the clinical role of Carica papaya extract in dengue and called for better-designed trials.

cases.indication: Clinically reliable weight loss in overweight adults
cases.title: Effects of Irvingia gabonensis seed extract supplementation on anthropometric and cardiovascular outcomes
cases.text: Five-trial systematic review found pooled weight-loss signals, but four trials had high risk of bias and the only low-risk trial did not show significant outcomes; overall efficacy was limited by poor methodological quality.

cases.indication: Relief of painful diabetic neuropathy with topical nutmeg extract
cases.title: Nutmeg Extracts for Painful Diabetic Neuropathy: a randomized double-blind controlled study
cases.text: Randomized double-blind controlled trial found improvements within both groups but no statistically significant between-group difference for pain outcomes after four weeks; further component-specific research was recommended.

cases.indication: Prevention of migraine attacks
cases.title: Feverfew for preventing migraine
cases.text: Systematic review of feverfew trials reported mixed findings and did not convincingly establish efficacy for migraine prevention across the evidence body.

cases.indication: Improvement of lipid profile in adults
cases.title: Effects of cardamom supplementation on lipid profile: systematic review and meta-analysis
cases.text: Clinical studies of cardamom and lipid outcomes reported contradictory results, leaving the body of evidence mixed rather than uniformly supportive.

cases.indication: Improvement of glycemic control in type 2 diabetes
cases.title: Effect of sesame consumption on glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes
cases.text: The systematic review identifies conflicting evidence on the effects of sesame consumption on glucose metabolism in patients with type 2 diabetes.

cases.indication: Improvement of cardiovascular risk factors in adults
cases.title: Effect of sumac (Rhus coriaria) on cardiovascular risk factors in adults
cases.text: Systematic review/meta-analysis notes that clinical findings on sumac and cardiovascular risk factors are controversial across trials.

cases.indication: Oral use of Nerium oleander preparations
cases.title: Human deaths related to oleander poisoning: a review
cases.text: Human oleander poisoning can cause severe cardiac arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death.

cases.indication: Oral ingestion of Taxus baccata material
cases.title: Serious plant poisonings in Switzerland: case analysis from the Swiss Toxicological Information Center
cases.text: Severe human Taxus baccata poisoning included tachyarrhythmia and fatal asystole.

cases.indication: Oral ingestion of Oenanthe crocata material
cases.title: Serious plant poisonings in Switzerland: case analysis from the Swiss Toxicological Information Center
cases.text: Severe human Oenanthe crocata poisoning included convulsions and a lethal coma.

cases.indication: Oral ingestion of Veratrum album material
cases.title: Serious plant poisonings in Switzerland: case analysis from the Swiss Toxicological Information Center
cases.text: Severe human Veratrum album poisoning included marked bradycardia and shock requiring medical care.

cases.indication: EU novel-food market access for chaga mushroom
cases.title: Commission Implementing Decision of 25 March 2022
cases.text: The European Commission terminated the procedure for authorising the placing on the market of chaga mushroom (Inonotus obliquus) without updating the Union list of novel foods.

cases.indication: EU novel-food market access for Coriolus versicolor
cases.title: Commission Implementing Decision of 6 December 2021
cases.text: The European Commission terminated the procedure for authorising the placing on the market of Coriolus versicolor without updating the Union list of novel foods.

cases.indication: EU novel-food market access for Laminaria digitata ash
cases.title: Commission Implementing Decision of 20 February 2026
cases.text: The European Commission terminated the procedure for authorising the placing on the market of Laminaria digitata ash without updating the Union list of novel foods.

cases.indication: EU market access for Lycium chinense leaves as traditional food from a third country
cases.title: Commission Implementing Decision of 30 June 2026
cases.text: The European Commission terminated the procedure for authorising the placing on the market of Lycium chinense Mill. (Goji) leaves as a traditional food from a third country without updating the Union list of novel foods.
